name: sleuth
summary: Read-only remote forensic incident response over SIREN, delivering verified ATT&CK findings; formal IR reports are written from those findings by the companion dossier skill.
notes: Risk class: public distribution, remote execution via SIREN, false-attribution risk. CI runs scripts/validate.py (skill metadata, guardrail and workflow markers, interface trust block, reference links, secret scan over tracked files) and the offline mock SIREN suite. SKILL.md is capped at 8 KiB and holds every must-follow rule. The generated trust report, permission probe, scorecards and waiver ledger were removed on 2026-11-20: they did not test agent behavior, and the output-lab pairs they tracked evaluate report writing, which moved to the dossier repository's skills/dossier package on 2026-11-09. sleuth ends at step 7 and hands findings over.
